The middle term of an arithmetic sequence is the average of its neighbors, so x = (3^2 + 3^4)/2 = (9 + 81)/2 = 45.

- Solution 1 computed (81 − 9)/2 = 36, which is half the difference rather than the average, so it is wrong.
- Solution 2 correctly adds half the difference to 9 (9 + 36 = 45) and gets 45, so it is correct. Its description of the common difference as 36 is right, and 81 − 36 = 45 is consistent.
- Solution 3 gave 49, which is wrong.
